title: Types of Communication
author: 637a4e2c89ac12120fbab5de
chapter_outcomes: Explain the differences between formal and informal communication, provide examples, and analyse how and why language changes depending on the audience.
Analyse how verbal and non-verbal communication, including body language, affect the effectiveness of face-to-face interactions.

Evaluate the suitability of different types of communication for internal stakeholders (e.g., managers, employees, shareholders) and external stakeholders (e.g., suppliers, customers, banks, local community, government).
Explain the need for careful planning of communications and events, considering possible outcomes before, during, and after, including timing, focus, and participation.
Analyse the importance of providing appropriate documents for meetings and presentations, including notices, agendas, minutes, visual aids, handouts, and formal reports.
Evaluate the effectiveness of meetings or presentations by analysing decisions made and determining whether objectives were achieved.
